checks.evidence: Dimensioned apartment subassemblies, fasteners, sash/rail/AC detail tooling exists; generated window optics separates two sliding glass leaves from the frame and interior backing instead of relying on one opaque window block. Occupant-controlled curtain dressing is a separate physical layer behind the repeated manufactured sash, with 30 deterministic assemblies, physical LOD0 pleats and LOD0/1/2/3 staging.
Generated detail geometry has a non-razor-edge replacement pass.
Danchi master geometry has explicit LOD staging; the apartment curtain layer independently uses four cross-faded LOD levels so close pleats are not paid at distance.

Root/trunk/branch/twig/leaf hierarchy tooling exists; tree anchors also receive root-zone planting interfaces rather than remaining visually disconnected from the plaza/grass substrate. Static clone-risk QA uses both fine root-normalized hierarchy fingerprints and a coarser perceptual signature that discards generated numeric suffixes and sub-threshold transform jitter, so procedural natural variation cannot pass solely by nudging branches or ecology instances by visually irrelevant amounts.

Two-sided foliage optics and transmission shader are present, with measured-order dielectric F0/GGX constraints and explicit QA. Cause-based understory uses the same thin-leaf optical model and four renderer-distinct cross-faded LOD levels with density reduced toward pedestrian-pressure sources.

Weathering remains driven by rain/splash/drain/contact/UV context rather than arbitrary grime. The facade pass reconstructs grade splash, sill/downpipe runoff, balcony drip residue, sparse rail-fixing rust and AC drain residue as non-colliding source-anchored meshes; vegetation density likewise follows ordinary maintenance/foot-traffic pressure rather than random decoration.

PBR generation includes physical-scale infrastructure micro maps, metre-derived macro/detail base-ground layers, a two-scale non-metallic facade coating, physically separated dielectric glazing, dry non-metallic weathering residue materials, root-zone soil/precast tree-pit materials, transmitted-light foliage, park/street-furniture PBR sets, and curtain-fabric families with textile normal/albedo structure. Active map registration/sampling and actual scene material metallic/specular ranges have dedicated QA.

One deterministic midsummer solar model drives SummerSun, procedural sky sun reference, sky-derived ambient fill and default specular environment. Two 512px HDR local reflection probes use ViaScripting/NoTimeSlicing and BlendProbesAndSkybox. The authoritative pre-capture path retains RenderIDs, yields to later EditorApplication.update callbacks, requires IsFinishedRendering(RenderID)=true plus created 512px Cube realtimeTexture, and writes both the runtime completion receipt and a fresh SHA-256-bound async-wait proof before benchmark Camera.Render is allowed.

Generated fallbacks remain replaceable by authored FBX/GLB art; facade optics and occupancy variation skip when the danchi authored-art slot is active. Vegetation ecology keys from stable tree-slot anchors, so authored tree replacement does not require moving the surrounding root-zone interface.

Per-component manufacture/material/angular-light-response registry exists, with foundation/grade, facade/glazing, apartment window dressing, environment, reflection synchronization, facade-weathering, vegetation-ecology, scene-repetition and park/street-furniture contracts. Metadata records manufacture, dimensions, mounting, clearances, albedo/roughness/metallic/F0/normal/microstructure/wetness/UV aging/angular response, geometry-vs-material split and LOD policy where applicable.

Dedicated 3840x2160 hero/oblique/grazing capture code with pixel-exact 100% crops rebuilds and saves the detailed benchmark before reflection synchronization. The complete review packet then requests both realtime cubemaps, returns control to the Editor, polls completion on later Editor updates, SHA-256 binds the async-wait proof to the exact completion receipt, and only then captures without rebuilding the scene. The benchmark filmic image effect now marks OnRenderImage with ImageEffectTransformsToLDR and exposes runtime-only counters/buffer telemetry. Immediately before the three synchronous still renders the packet resets that telemetry; immediately after them it requires exactly three 3840x2160 filmic invocations, zero fallback blits, an observed floating-point HDR source and an observed non-HDR destination before period crops or render provenance can be sealed. That runtime receipt is explicitly non-scoring and still requires pixel review.

Capture contract records exact hero/oblique/grazing view/crop paths plus intended sky/reflection state and explicitly remains unrendered until Unity executes it. Reflection synchronization has a runtime completion receipt plus a separate fresh async-wait proof hash-bound to that receipt rather than relying on the manifest Boolean or a same-call-stack RenderProbe check. The HDR-tonemap contract separately requires real runtime observation of the display-transform buffer path and cannot award points from source configuration alone. No static check is allowed to clear a critical visual defect.

latestRun.verification: GitHub source/static inspection plus current Unity documentation review only. Audit found that the benchmark had an HDR-enabled Forward camera and an ACES-like filmic OnRenderImage shader, but the image effect did not explicitly declare the HDR-to-LDR transition. Unity documents ImageEffectTransformsToLDR as the image-effect marker that requests an LDR destination and makes the effect responsible for LDR-range output; Unity 6 Built-in documentation also states that Forward HDR depends on a camera post-processing effect. The filmic method now carries that marker and records runtime-only invocation, native-resolution, fallback and source/destination RenderTexture telemetry. A new QA gate resets the counters immediately before the authoritative hero/oblique/grazing Camera.Render calls and refuses sealing unless exactly three native 3840x2160 tonemap executions occurred with no fallback, the source format is observed HDR and the destination format is observed LDR. The native review packet runs the contract preflight before scene preparation and the runtime proof immediately around still capture. No Unity runner/workflow exists on this branch, Assets/QA/Captures4K remains absent, and no rendered pixels were reviewed, so this remains implementation/evidence-readiness work only.
expectedVisualScoreImpact: Cinematic image quality/composition/color/exposure: protects the intended filmic highlight shoulder and exposure transform from an implicit/ambiguous HDR-to-LDR boundary, but awards no points without the actual image.

Lighting/shadows/reflections: preserves high-intensity sun/specular information until the display transform so future highlight clipping deductions are based on the intended pipeline rather than premature truncation.

Material/PBR physical plausibility: keeps dielectric/metal highlight energy available to the filmic transform; physical plausibility still must be judged from the native hero/oblique/grazing evidence.

Evidence integrity: authoritative stills cannot be sealed if the filmic shader falls back, does not execute three times at native resolution, or fails to show an HDR-source to LDR-destination transition at runtime.
